description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

You grow a tumour of incredible size somewhere on your body. Roll on the @Table[hitloc]{Hit Locations} Table to determine where. The tumour weighs 1d10x10 pounds and for every 30 pounds you gain +1 Wound and one of the following (Roll 1d10): 1-3, -1 Movement; 4-6, -10 Agility; 7-10; -10 Fellowship.
